name: Kemecse (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the town arms of Kemecse: a quartered blue and green shield with waves, a church, ears of grain and a bunch of grapes, inscribed KEMECSE on a yellow chief.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
